name: Permian Period
description: Explore the era of the great Pangaean supercontinent and the greatest mass extinction in Earth's history.

questions.question: Which supercontinent was forming during the Permian period?
questions.explain: The Permian saw the final assembly of the supercontinent Pangaea.

questions.question: What is the name of the mass extinction event at the end of the Permian?
questions.explain: The Permian-Triassic extinction is often called the Great Dying due to its scale.

questions.question: Which group of amphibians reached their peak diversity during this period?
questions.explain: Temnospondyls were a major group of extinct amphibians dominant in the Permian.

questions.question: Which reptile-like group began to dominate land habitats during the Permian?
questions.explain: Synapsids, the precursors to mammals, were the dominant land vertebrates.

questions.question: What was a major environmental feature of the Permian landmass?
questions.explain: The vast interior of Pangaea created highly arid and desert-like conditions.

questions.question: Which plant group was highly successful in the Permian's dry environments?
questions.explain: Gymnosperms, like conifers, thrived in the drier Permian climates.

questions.question: What was a primary driver of the Permian-Triassic extinction?
questions.explain: Massive volcanism in the Siberian Traps is the leading theory for the extinction.

questions.question: Which marine group saw a massive decline during the end-Permian?
questions.explain: The extinction wiped out a vast majority of marine invertebrates, including these groups.

questions.question: What characterizes the Permian geological time scale position?
questions.explain: The Permian is the final period of the Paleozoic Era.

questions.question: Which organism is often associated with the Permian fossil record?
questions.explain: Dimetrodon is a famous sail-backed synapsid from the Permian period.
